topics.label: Introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture with introductory framing on the importance and complexity of the complement system.

topics.label: Foundations and core principles of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts and core molecular architecture of the complement system prior to pathway activation.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three pathways that initiate the complement cascade and drive the system toward its trigger threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector mechanisms through which activated complement eradicates pathogens.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanisms host cells use to regulate complement activity and prevent self-damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the clinical manifestations and disease outcomes associated with specific complement deficiencies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms and applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens evade complement-mediated destruction and how these mechanisms are applied therapeutically and experimentally.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture with concluding remarks and previews the upcoming session.
